senses.definition: Pf. intr. רִם Dn 5:20 lifted up, of heart, i.e. presumptuous. Pōʿl. extol: Pt. מְרוֹמֵם 4:34 (ל dei).
exalt: Pt. מָרִים 5:19 (acc. pers.). Hithpōʿl. lift oneself up against, Pf. 2 ms. הִתְרוֹמַמְתָּ 5:23 (על dei).
